start.title: [TODO:es] The Shore
start.text:
[TODO:es] The boat lands in strange country.
A distant cry tears the silence.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay With Him
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He does not turn back.
Walk where he walks.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Come Out
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His presence is your shelter.
Walk beside him.

tombs.title: [TODO:es] Among the Tombs
tombs.text:
[TODO:es] Broken chains scatter the ground.
A man lives among the dead.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Have Compassion
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He is tormented, not despised.
Look with mercy.

villagers.title: [TODO:es] The Villagers' Fear
villagers.text:
[TODO:es] Villagers warn, "No one can bind him."
They beg you to leave.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Do Not Flee
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Their fear is not your faith.
Stand with him.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Watch and Trust
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] This hour is for witnessing.
Be still and see.

confront.title: [TODO:es] He Runs to Jesus
confront.text:
[TODO:es] The man falls down before him.
"What do you want with me?"

step_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Let Him Act
step_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your hands cannot heal here.
Only his voice can.

command.title: [TODO:es] Come Out of Him
command.text:
[TODO:es] Jesus speaks, calm and clear.
"Come out of this man."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:es] See What Follows
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Open your eyes to his power.
The demons hear him.

cover_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Hear His Voice
cover_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His word frees the captive.
Listen.

pigs.title: [TODO:es] Into the Herd
pigs.text:
[TODO:es] The herd rushes down the cliff.
The man lies still and silent.

mourn_consequence.title: [TODO:es] A Soul Is Worth More
mourn_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He is worth more than many herds.
Rejoice.

restored.title: [TODO:es] Go and Tell
restored.text:
[TODO:es] The man sits clothed, in his right mind.
"Tell what the Lord has done."
